## 🔍 Overview

Reading through long documents to pull out the important parts is slow. **Document Summary Assistant** fixes that: upload a document, pick how much detail you want back, and get a clean, structured summary — an **executive summary**, **key highlights**, and **extracted structured data** — generated in seconds.

It's built on **Groq**, which runs LLM inference on purpose-built LPU hardware instead of general-purpose GPUs, so responses come back noticeably faster than most typical API-based summarizers, even on longer documents.

## ✨ Features

**Document handling**
- 📤 Upload PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT, or image files — up to 25MB
- ⚠️ Automatic validation catches files with no extractable text (e.g. a plain photo) before wasting an API call

**Summarization**
- 🎚️ Three summary lengths — Short, Medium, Long — so output matches how much detail you actually need
- ⚡ Groq-powered inference for fast, low-latency responses
- 🔗 LangChain handles parsing and prompt orchestration end-to-end
- 📊 Every summary comes back structured: **Executive Summary**, **Key Highlights**, and **Extracted Structured Data**

**Experience**
- 🎨 Clean dark-mode UI with purple gradient accents
- 🖱️ One-click generation — no config beyond choosing a length

## 📎 Supported File Types

| Format | Extension | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| PDF | `.pdf` | Text-based PDFs |
| Word Document | `.docx` | |
| Spreadsheet | `.csv` | |
| Plain Text | `.txt` | |
| Image | `.jpg`, `.png`, etc. | Requires readable/extractable text |

Max upload size: **25MB**

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology | Why |
|---|---|---|
| App / UI | [Streamlit](https://streamlit.io/) | Fast to build, clean Python-native UI |
| LLM orchestration | [LangChain](https://www.langchain.com/) | Manages parsing → prompt → response flow |
| LLM inference | [Groq API](https://groq.com/) | LPU hardware for very fast inference |
| Language | Python 3.9+ | |

## 🏗️ Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[📤 Upload Document] --> B{Readable Text Found?}
    B -- No --> C[⚠️ Validation Warning]
    B -- Yes --> D[🦜 LangChain: Parse & Build Prompt]
    D --> E[⚡ Groq LLM Inference]
    E --> F[📊 Structured Summary:<br/>Executive Summary + Key Highlights + Extracted Data]
```

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.9+
- A free [Groq API key](https://console.groq.com/keys)

### Installation

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/your-username/document-summary-assistant.git
cd document-summary-assistant

# Create and activate a virtual environment
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate      # Windows: venv\Scripts\activate

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Add your Groq API key
echo "GROQ_API_KEY=your_groq_api_key_here" > .env

# Run the app
streamlit run app.py
```

The app opens at `http://localhost:8501`.

### Environment Variables

| Variable | Description | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `GROQ_API_KEY` | Your API key from [console.groq.com](https://console.groq.com/keys) | ✅ Yes |

> 💡 Adjust the repo URL, requirements file, and entry-point filename if yours differ — these follow standard Streamlit project conventions.

## 🧑‍💻 Usage

1. Open the app in your browser
2. Upload a PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT, or image file (max 25MB)
3. Select a summary length — Short, Medium, or Long
4. Click **Generate Smart Summary**
5. Review the executive summary, key highlights, and extracted structured data

## ❓ FAQ

**What happens if I upload a file with no readable text (like a photo)?**
You'll get a clear validation warning instead of a broken or empty summary.

**What's the maximum file size?**
25MB per upload.

**Which LLM provider does this use?**
Inference runs through the Groq API, orchestrated with LangChain.

**Do I need my own API key?**
Yes — a free Groq API key is required. See [Getting Started](#-getting-started).
